content:
Let \(T\) be the given expression. Since
\[
a*b+1=(a+1)(b+1),
\]
the operation is associative after shifting by \(1\). Thus
\[
T+1=\prod_{k=2}^{11}\left(1+\frac1k\right)
=\prod_{k=2}^{11}\frac{k+1}{k}
=\frac{3}{2}\cdot\frac{4}{3}\cdots\frac{12}{11}
=\frac{12}{2}=6.
\]
So
\[
T=6-1=5.
\]
\[
\boxed{5}
\]
